title: Where net1 v7's traffic head misfires beside a Cubic flow that started first: by time, open and closed loop
description: Taking the belief in copies from net1 v7's traffic head (exp-traffic-head-v7-300) gains 0.30 to 0.42 among copies but loses 0.14 to 0.25 beside a Cubic flow that started first, the validation family whose episodes last 60 s, where round 33's own students gain (exp-traffic-r33h-val-304). The head was trained on 30 s episodes with the fixed rule as the observed flow. This runs, on the validation links at campaign seed 21 for 60 s, alone with a Cubic flow from 0 s (cubic-first) and under the training family's three conditions (one of them a Cubic flow from 8 s), two observed flows with every step kept: the fixed rule on net1 v7 at u = 0.25 (rule-v7, the head's training-time flow) and round 33's seed 1 at iteration 59 with its belief in copies from the head (net2-r33h-s1, the closed loop). experiments/traffic_head_val.py scores the head on each (val-NAME/summary.md), with the share of steps called copies and the mean P(copies) by time since the flow started. What would follow, stated before the results: if the head calls a Cubic flow copies mostly after 30 s, it needs longer training episodes; if it does so under the closed loop but not beside the fixed rule, its training data must come from the policies that read it.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); H="$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; echo "62043107ace9c7c3c913124f42d26023474ec6108cc59d959475da6bd57820be  $H" | sha256sum -c; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s1"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s1"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/traffic_head.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cmp "$e/traffic_head.pt" "$H"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" net2-r33h-s1 "$e" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H"; for n in "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" "net2-r33h-s1=$OUT/p/net2-r33h-s1.onnx"; do a=${n%%=*}; for f in cubic-first training; do uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$a-$f" --split val --family "$f" --duration-ms 60000 --seed 21 --stock "" --policy "$n"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$a-$f/campaign.json" "$OUT/obs-$a/c-$f"; done; done; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/obs-*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: for a in rule-v7 net2-r33h-s1; do mkdir -p "$OUT/val-$a"; uv run python experiments/traffic_head_val.py "$OUT/val-$a" "$OUT/obs-$a" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; done; { for a in rule-v7 net2-r33h-s1; do echo "## Observed flow $a"; echo; cat "$OUT/val-$a/summary.md"; echo; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"; rm -f "$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25-actor.pt"
